On Bracken Isle, a battered stone lighthouse guards the approach to the Saltgate, the abandoned harbour of the grand city of Saint Calder. When the moon is eclipsed by a dark object nobody understands, the tides turn savage, storms rise, and people come apart. Tonight the beacon has failed, and a passenger ship is heading for a harbour nobody uses.

Earth-like physics and weather, with one exception: a seasonal eclipse in which an unknown dark spherical object hovers over the moon and blocks it out. While the moon is covered, tides become more aggressive and storm season begins. See [[geography]] and [[sys_eclipse]].
